messages.author: de80823ab00b5d5b
messages.subject: Re: How to remove y axis scale and label for box plot
parts:
You can view options by

theme_get()

Here, we see options that correspond to the axis. One way to modify these is:

p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(factor(cyl), mpg))
p <- p + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = cyl, colour = cyl), size = 1.9)
p <- p + opts(axis.text.x = theme_blank(), axis.title.x=theme_blank())
p
